request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  502
error[ZC-E0213]: the store connection dropped during an operation
  cause  libpq reported: server closed the connection unexpectedly
  cause  the connection to Postgres dropped; nothing was changed
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    retry the command; zcube reconnects before the next operation
  more   zcube explain E0213
